newsitem.title: UK: Granada to sell hotels for 90 mln stg-paper.
newsitem.headline: Granada to sell hotels for 90 mln stg-paper.

text.p: Granada Group Plc is expected to announce on Tuesday the sale of its two Westbury hotels for around 90 million pounds ($145.8 million), the Guardian newspaper reported.
The hotels in London and New York are expected to be sold to property group Chelsfield, the newspaper said.

Later in the week the television and leisure group is set to reveal the winner of the auction for the Welcome Break motorway services business, which is seen fetching more than 400 million pounds ($648 million). ($1=.6173 Pound)
